argv:
The daily digest email has three problems:

1. People who never opted into the digest receive one. Anyone who has changed any notification setting in a workspace, even without choosing digest delivery for anything, starts getting that workspace's digest. Only people who chose digest delivery for at least one kind of notification in the workspace may receive its digest.
2. On busy days, when a recipient has more unread updates in the digest window than fit into one digest (the digest is capped), the digest keeps the oldest updates and drops the most recent ones, and the email leads with the oldest update. The digest must keep the most recent updates, listed newest first, so the email's headline is the most recent update.
3. Workspaces that have been deleted (archived) keep sending digest emails at their digest hour. An archived workspace must send no digest at all; live workspaces are unaffected.

This is a `fix` task: edit the code and stop. Do not write a summary and do not emit an ANSWER line.
